name: Srivatsav Auswin
description: I’m Srivatsav Auswin, an open-source contributor and developer. I’ve worked extensively on FOSSASIA’s Eventyay ecosystem, contributing to areas such as live event check-ins, badge printing, exhibitor tools, and platform integrations. I’m also an organizer with the open-source student community and currently work at Microsoft, while continuing to contribute to open-source software and developer communities.
